issues.summary: Graceful degradation covers only an UNSET GAS_READ_TOKEN, not a stale/rejected one. post_pull (ingest.py:139-180) resolves the token and, if falsy, drops weeks_verified_empty and keeps pulling. If the token is present but no longer matches API_READ_TOKEN — the exact failure this project has already hit twice (see memory: gas-read-token-name-mismatch, token-mismatch-rotate-typed-not-debug-clipboard, and the rotation path in docs/api.md) — GAS answers {result:'error', message:'unauthorized'} with NO `code` field (Code.gs:145), so _send() cannot distinguish it from any other rejection and raises IngestFailed. runner.py:402 catches it and returns 1 AFTER earlier chunks have already been written to the ShopSpend tab, and the final pull-marker POST never runs — so the pull lands partial data with no ShopSpendPulls row, and the ShopSpend Report loses the banner/diagnostics for that pull. This contradicts what docs/api.md:143-147 and PRD-9 promise ('degrades non-destructively ... keeps pulling when the token is unresolvable'): an invalid token is at least as likely as an absent one and is the only new failure mode this phase introduces. Nothing in test_ingest.py exercises a token-rejected response (the 5 new degradation tests all monkeypatch get_credential to return None). Suggested fix: have GAS return code:'UNAUTHORIZED' on the doPost gate and have _send/post_pull treat that code on a weeks_verified_empty chunk as the same degradation — retry the chunk once without weeks_verified_empty + warn — instead of aborting the pull.

PRD-9 (line 25) is still status `planned` even though the phase covering it has completed all 5 steps. PRD.md's own rule directly under the table says to flip planned -> built when the covering phase completes, and step 4 was the docs-closeout step declaring covers:[PRD-9] — so the closeout step left its own PRD row stale.

The degradation path leaves the pull marker internally inconsistent in one remaining place. It appends the warning to pull['warnings'] / pull['warnings_count'] and rewrites diagnostics_json.harness (weeks_verified_empty cleared + verified_empty_dropped flag), but diagnostics_json also carries its own top-level 'warnings' array (populated from diag.warnings at runner.py:218), which is left without the degradation message. The two warning lists in the same marker now disagree. The Sheet-facing banner reads the warnings column (shopspend.gs:322 -> pull[8]), so the user-visible surface is correct; this is a diagnostics-blob consistency wart, not a data-correctness bug.

The phase is registered as {"dir":"dopost-auth-minors","status":"error","failed_at":"2026-08-05T15:00:37+0900"} while phases/dopost-auth-minors/index.json shows all 5 steps `completed` (steps started 15:20+, i.e. after that failed_at stamp). Stale harness state from an aborted earlier run; leaves the phase index claiming a failure that the step records contradict.

No privilege separation between read and write: the new doPost gate (Code.gs:143-146) reuses checkReadToken_/API_READ_TOKEN, so any holder of the read-only doGet credential is also authorized to POST weeks_verified_empty and bypass the blast-radius breaker (a destructive tombstone path). This is what PRD-9 specifies and it is strictly better than the previous unauthenticated write path, so it is not a regression — but a distinct API_WRITE_TOKEN would keep a leaked read credential from carrying destructive capability. Jake's call, worth a follow-up item rather than a rework.
